subject: Request: temporary invoice cutover + net90 bridge for Harbor Therapeutics
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@harbortx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@harbortx.com>, Procurement <procurement@harbortx.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing cadence ask — Harbor Therapeutics (PO attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. Procurement asked me to send the formal request for a temporary change to our billing cadence to align Redwood invoices to Harbor's fiscal schedule. Two asks:

- Move to quarterly invoicing starting Q3 (invoice at start of each fiscal quarter)
- Allow net90 on invoices for the first two quarters while we finalize internal budget approvals (Harbor is converting fiscal calendars)

We have a PO ready (attached). This will speed contract signature on our side. We understand this is outside standard terms — happy to discuss guarantees or a deposit.

Can you route to your finance/deal desk for approval? We need confirmation by end of week to hit Harbor procurement deadlines.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Harbor Therapeutics

Attachment: Harbor-PO-20270609.pdf

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@harbortx.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence ask — Harbor Therapeutics (PO attached)

Elena — thanks for the note and the PO. Appreciate the heads-up on the fiscal calendar change. I will escalate to deal desk/finance.

Quick note on what we can move on short notice: we are prepared to offer a temporary bridge that balances cash protection for Redwood with Harbor's procurement timeline. Proposed bridge (pending executive sign-off):

- 30% prepay at signature (applied to first invoice)
- Quarterly invoicing schedule for 6 months
- Net90 on the remaining balance for the first two quarters only; revert to standard net30 thereafter
- No more than 20% total discount across the term (if pricing adjustment required)

I'll attach a short MAP and send a formal exec request — copying the internal folks who should review.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-proposal-Harbor-20270609.pdf

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence ask — Harbor Therapeutics (PO attached)

+1 on Karthik's bridge. Commercial rationale: Harbor is a strategic oncology partner with upsell potential; accelerating close improves Q3 bookings. Conditions to approve from my side:

- Finance must sign off on the prepay and aged receivable exposure
- Legal to add an SOW amendment clarifying payment schedule and rollback to net30 after two quarters
- Discount must be limited to 20% and documented in a one-page commercial memo

If finance/legal are comfortable, I support. Priyom — can you update the deal in HubSpot and ensure the appropriate revenue hold accounting?

Jonas Weber
Head of Enterprise Sales

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: EXEC SIGNOFF REQUEST — Harbor Therapeutics (D-2027-045)

Team — asking for quick exec/finance signoff so we can return to Harbor this afternoon. Summary:

- Customer: Harbor Therapeutics (Life sciences, strategic)
- ARR: $480k first-year booking, $1.2M TAM over 36 months (forecast)
- Ask: Quarterly invoicing + net90 on remainder for first two quarters
- Proposed Commercial Bridge (recommended): 30% prepay at signature; quarterly invoices; net90 on remaining balance for Q3 and Q4 only; revert to net30 thereafter
- Risk mitigations: prepay deposit, standard credit hold language, updated SOW amendment, discount cap 20% if any pricing concession needed
- Attachments: PO from Harbor; MAP with milestones; HubSpot deal link
- Requested decision: approve bridge (as outlined) or propose alternative (e.g., net60 instead of net90).

Business rationale: this unlocks a strategic reference customer and materially accelerates Q3 bookings while keeping exposure limited via deposit and timebox.

Please reply with APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CHANGE / DENY. If APPROVE, I will route paperwork to Legal and Finance immediately.

Thanks — Karthik

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EXEC SIGNOFF REQUEST — Harbor Therapeutics (D-2027-045)

Karthik / Jonas — finance reviewed. Conditional approval granted with the following controls:

1) Change net90 request to net60 for the second quarter (we can accept net90 on the first quarter only).
2) 30% prepay is required and must be received before provisioning; payment method must be wire/ACH (no exceptions).
3) Legal must include invoice rollback clause and a 30-day remediation window in the SOW amendment.
4) Finance to place a revenue hold code and require AR weekly check-ins for 60 days.

If Harbor accepts the above, finance signs off and legal will produce a one-page amendment. Karthik — please confirm and ask Harbor to send updated PO/ACH details.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
